testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-amount-off-product-coupon-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify amount off product coupon functionality

scenario.summary: As a guest, an Amount Off Product coupon is rejected for a product it does not cover, then applies to the eligible product added at quantity 5 (flat amount per unit). The guest signs in and the coupon must persist on the merged cart. Cart is cleaned up; no order. The spec is test.fixme today.
steps: Guest: empty the cart and remove any coupon
Add the other product (sku1) at qty 1, apply couponCode: Invalid coupon code, no discount; remove coupon, empty cart
Add the eligible product (sku2) at quantity, apply couponCode: one line, discount label, success message, coupon row
Check discount = discountAmount x row quantity and order total = subtotal - discount
Sign in from the header as the registered user, reopen the cart: discount label, success message and coupon row still shown
Remove coupon, empty cart, log out
stateChanges: Coupon is created per run through the API (consumable COUPON_* key); the test only applies and removes it, no order is placed, so one redemption is enough
Guest cart merged into the registered user's cart on sign-in; emptied at cleanup
assertions: Other product: invalid message "- " + invalidCouponMessage, coupon row shows couponCode, no discount
Eligible product: one line item, discount label visible, success message "- " + promoAppliedSuccesssMessage, coupon row shows couponCode
Discount close to discountAmount x quantity (precision 2); order total close to subtotal - discount
After sign-in: discount label, success message and coupon row still present
Empty cart message equals emptyShoppingCartMessage; sign-in link visible after logout
evidence: Title: 'verify amount off product coupon functionality'
The test is declared with test.fixme: step 4 (coupon persists after sign-in) did not reproduce on atstage with AMTOFFPROD4; the spec comment suspects a profile restriction
The created coupon applies to guest and registered profiles (allProfiles true), so step 4 can pass with it
Profile: AMTOFFPROD4 is an Amount Off Product coupon on MaxwellsHardware, discount 10.0, orderMinimum 10.0; sku2 z-2100023 (eligible) and sku1 z-4567890 (other) are active in-stock simple products
Discount assertions use the resolved coupon's discountAmount (role data), not the literal 10.00
Link: the coupon is created for product (productId @product.productId); otherProduct is a different record by the distinct rule, so the coupon does not cover it
allProfiles true (applies before and after sign-in), so no profile
